positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered ion beam/plasma deposited coatings to obtain customer driven properties  including high abrasion resistance, opacity, high optical transmittance, and hermeticity 
- Conducted research on next generation material processing for implantable devices by developing a biocompatible coating encompassing the device for full hermeticity
- Identified key metrics to understand reactor performance and created a macro-enabled Excel spreadsheet that reformats .html and .csv data into insightful trend charts that highlight inconsistencies

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Investigated a new nanophase found in the iron (III) oxide - zirconia binary oxide system.  Explored the alumina - zirconia binary oxide system in an attempt to produce a nanophase by using a heat treatment process slightly altered from the process required for the iron oxide - zirconia nanophase.  Prepared powder mixtures in ISO 6/Class 1000 clean room, worked with high temperature box furnaces to sinter at temperatures above 1200 C, and optically analyzed the heat treated samples under TEM.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Investigated a proposal to toughen high aspect ratio, nanoporous aluminum oxide films, under guidance of Dr. N. Strandwitz.  Much research experience was gained including background information research by connecting with various databases, as well as becoming acquainted with working in lab.

projects.title: SuperFriend
projects.description:
Superfriend helps its users keep in touch with close friends by calculating appropriate times to send reminders for when you should reach out to your friends.
PERN (Postgres, Express, React w/ Redux, Node.js) stack web app with Electron desktop app
